notes.title: Check out our newest game: shapez 2 is 25% off!
notes.content:
Did you check out our newest game already? You can now pick up shapez 2 with 25% off, the deepest discount so far!

shapez 2 is a top-down factory-building game where you extract and process geometric shapes. Each shape is its own set of building-blocks that your factories can take apart, stack, paint and put back together in unique ways. Build and automate to produce distinct shapes and solve the production challenge of each goal.

Automate the processing of abstract geometric shapes into more complex ones by cutting, rotating, stacking, painting and more. Deliver distinct shapes to unlock new technologies and expand your factory’s capabilities. Learn, improve, rebuild and solve logistical challenges to design the most efficient shape production lines.

Discount is available until November 25th!

Check out the shapez 2 page for more information:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2162800/shapez_2/

notes.title: YORG.io Standalone is coming on May 23th!
notes.content:
I'm super happy to announce that the YORG.io Standalone will be released on the 23th of May!

The standalone features many improvements over the online YORG.io:

- No advertisements
- Improved performance and less lag
- Synchronize your savegames accross all of your devices using SteamCloud
- Quality of live improvements like an improved start screen

And if you are wondering: You will of course be able to use your old savegames in the standalone - I will make another annoucement soon explaining how to import them.
